data.title: 伽玛 · 咖啡馆新品试吃
data.description: 四越咖啡馆午后暂歇，伽玛系着围裙在吧台试饮新调的饮品。她闭目抿了一口，手边摊着配方纸，准备根据味道调整分量。
data.location: cozy trading company cafe interior with a wooden counter, cups and pastry displays
data.action: standing alone at the counter, eyes closed while tasting a drink, recipe notes beside the cup
data.lighting: 咖啡馆午后透过格窗的柔和日光
data.promptProse: During a quiet afternoon break, Gamma tastes a new drink alone at the wooden cafe counter, eyes closed, with recipe notes and pastries beside her.
data.animaCaption: Gamma pauses over the cup, considering the flavor before marking her notes.
